instruct: A woman's voice, low-warm and dry-witted — the wry smile is clearly audible, a teasing deadpan delivery, as if she's already made the joke privately and is letting you catch up. Unhurried, level, confident; plainspoken with light irony, never harsh, never rushed.

text: The crossing held, and your work is real on the other side — that's my favorite part. It always is. No one sounds a horn for ten thousand quiet nights of the bridge simply holding, so I mention it myself, now and then. Go on across. I'll be here.
